_doc: Corrections applied on top of _n64map.json + _n64map_ext.json (st_load.n64_map). Each entry was checked by a replay against Mupen.

evidence.sCUpCameraPitch: 0x8033C770 (Skynet, static_map.py, checked on the .st RAM). task6.st: with -2096 there in sCUpCameraPitch and sCSideButtonYaw left at 0, the camera yaw of the optimise replay matches the Mupen trace (it diverged at poll 13 otherwise)
evidence.sCSideButtonYaw: n64map_build had put it at 0x8033C770 (value coincidence on the castle snapshots); real address unknown -> not copied
evidence.sSegmentTable: entry 0x13 = 0x000EB180 (physical base of the behavior segment, bhvMario at 0x800EE040) in 07_pied_escalier_bob.st, f09900.st and task6.st; the only such table; referenced by lw/sw in the N64 code. Read only (memory.c state is never copied)
evidence.sInteractionHandlers: interaction.c, from the N64 code references (n64_coderefs): .data starts at 0x8032D950 (16-aligned after level_update.c), sInteractionHandlers 31 x 8 bytes -> 0x8032DA48 = first lw-referenced table (sForwardKnockbackActions, 3x3 u32), +0x24 = 0x8032DA6C (sBackwardKnockbackActions, lw), +0x24 = 0x8032DA90/94/98 = three u8 accessed by lbu/sb (the three static u8, 4-aligned in .data). .bss: 0x8033B270 lbu/sb (u8 sDelayInvincTimer) and 0x8033B272 lh/sh (s16 sInvulnerable), right after level_update.c. Needed by the key-door state f10940 (sDisplayingDoorText)

evidence.s8DirModeBaseYaw: camera.c statics, from the N64 code references (n64_coderefs: s16 lh/sh at 0x8033C768, C76A, C770, C772, C774, C776, C778; f32 at C764, C76C, C77C, C780) and the declaration order (= the host DLL order, reversed): sZoomAmount, sCSideButtonYaw, sBehindMarioSoundTimer, sZeroZoomDist, sCUpCameraPitch (C770), sModeOffsetYaw (C772), sSpiralStairsYawOffset (C774), s8DirModeBaseYaw (C776), s8DirModeYawOffset (C778), sPanDistance (C77C), sCannonYOffset (C780). The base map had sBehindMarioSoundTimer at C776. Needed by the 8-direction camera (mode 14: target yaw = base + offset): SM64 Island secretarea_apres_warp.st has base 0, offset -32768 (= its nextYaw); without them the camera turned the wrong way (intendedYaw off by 0x800 at frame 2).
